title: Transparency
intro: Compile half-yearly figures from Vireek's own records, add the text, get counsel approval, then publish. Nothing is public until you publish.

types.pii_leak_on_call: Personal data shared on a call

reports.suppressHelp: A rule for small numbers. Counsel decides whether and what to use. Leave empty for exact counts.
reports.empty: No reports yet. Create one for the last closed half-year.
reports.recompileNote: Recompiling changes an approved report back to draft only if the figures changed.
reports.rulesHelp: State every rule counsel approved: rounding, suppression, delays, what is not reported.

publishBlocker.notApproved: Only an approved report can be published.
publishBlocker.periodOpen: The period has not ended yet.

reports.confirmPublish: Publish {{period}}? It becomes public immediately and cannot be edited afterwards.
reports.confirmWithdraw: Withdraw this report from the public page?

log.intro: Write for the public, not for the incident team. Describe what happened and what changed, never who was involved.
log.title: Title
log.redactionDone: I checked every rule above by hand
log.confirmPublish: Publish this entry? It becomes public immediately and cannot be edited afterwards.
log.confirmWithdraw: Withdraw this entry from the public page?

rules.no_names: No names of customers, callers, employees or technicians.
rules.no_addresses: No street addresses, cities of a caller or other location detail.
rules.no_business_identifiers: No customer business names unless counsel approved them.
rules.no_internal_ids: No call, ticket, account or internal incident ids.
rules.no_transcript_quotes: No quotes from calls or transcripts.
rules.no_security_detail: No detail that helps someone repeat an attack.
rules.no_speculation: No guesses about cause or blame. State what is confirmed.

errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.redaction: The text contains something that must not be published ({{rule}}). Remove it and try again.
errors.gate: A required step is missing (text, redaction check or counsel approval).
errors.immutable: Published content cannot be edited. Add a correction or withdraw it.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.future: The date cannot be in the future.
